name: Olivia Ultra Protect+ Sunscreen SPF 40
form_factor: 100ml soft-squeeze tube, teal flip-cap, standing on cap
dimensions: ~15cm tall, fits fully in one hand with cap above thumb
finish_behavior: matte tube diffuses light softly with a gentle sheen along the cylinder; glossy cap takes one crisp specular highlight

label.rule: label is ALWAYS image-referenced, never text-prompted

hero_angle: three-quarter front, tilted back 10° — daisy artwork and SPF badge both catch light
avoid_angles: straight-on top-down (cap hides label), extreme side (artwork wraps out of view)
usage_gesture: squeeze a pea-sized dot onto two fingers, dot onto cheekbones, blend outward
contents_behavior: white lightweight cream, medium-low viscosity, spreads to a satin finish with no cast
audience: skincare-aware women 22-38 who read ingredient lists
competitor_look: either clinical white-lab or loud beach party — we take the third door: warm botanical morning light
